title: Sparkly helicopter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFD93D'>
    <polygon points='15,25 17,30 22,30 18,34 20,40 15,36 10,40 12,34 8,30 13,30'/>
    <polygon points='82,20 84,25 89,25 85,29 87,35 82,31 77,35 79,29 75,25 80,25'/>
    <polygon points='88,60 90,65 95,65 91,69 93,75 88,71 83,75 85,69 81,65 86,65'/>
    <polygon points='12,65 14,70 19,70 15,74 17,80 12,76 7,80 9,74 5,70 10,70'/>
    <polygon points='50,10 51,14 55,14 52,17 53,21 50,18 47,21 48,17 45,14 49,14'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Helicopter body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#E85D3A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='26' ry='18' fill='none' stroke='#F28C6A' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Cockpit window -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='50' rx='10' ry='11' fill='#9DE0F5'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='50' rx='10' ry='11' fill='none' stroke='#C8EEFF' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='46' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#D9F4FF' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Tail boom -->
  <rect x='18' y='50' width='18' height='8' rx='3' fill='#C94A2B'/>
  <!-- Tail rotor -->
  <ellipse cx='16' cy='54' rx='3' ry='10' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <ellipse cx='16' cy='54' rx='10' ry='3' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='54' r='3' fill='#F5A623'/>
  <!-- Main rotor mast -->
  <rect x='47' y='30' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#B33A1F'/>
  <!-- Main rotor blades -->
  <rect x='15' y='27' width='70' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#F5A623'/>
  <rect x='15' y='27' width='70' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <!-- Rotor hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='4' fill='#E85D3A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='2' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <!-- Landing skids -->
  <rect x='30' y='72' width='4' height='8' rx='1' fill='#8A8A9E'/>
  <rect x='64' y='72' width='4' height='8' rx='1' fill='#8A8A9E'/>
  <rect x='26' y='78' width='50' height='4' rx='2' fill='#A0A0B4'/>
  <!-- Body stripe -->
  <path d='M30 58 Q50 64 70 58' stroke='#FFD93D' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
